lines.after_deadline: I'm sorry, the latest date I can accept is {date}.
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day could you pay?

lines.recorded: Thank you, your promise has been recorded.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, the promise could not be recorded because of a technical problem.
lines.paid_line: Thank you for letting me know. Our team will check the payment.

lines.hardship: I'm sorry to hear that. I'll put you through to our Care team now, who can help.

lines.human_ask_help: I can help with most questions about your account. Is there something I can help you with?
lines.transfer: Please hold while I transfer you.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer did not go through.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't book the callback.
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system is not responding right now.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?

unsupported_rules: "Otherwise `no_promise` with the reason of the first product (in handling order) whose note is not a paid note: `refused` or `dispute`." The format can either take the first product's ending or rank endings globally. It cannot express 'first non-paid product in handling order'.

"Where the memo gives a start date, the earlier text still applies to calls before that date." For calls before 30 October 2026, memo items 1, 2 and 4 do not apply. That means band A deadline the 7th business day, 2026-11-13 a closure day, 2026-11-30 not a closure day, and an overdraft floor of 25%. Only code changes can be dated in this format. The spec carries the memo values in force from 30 October 2026.

rules.opening_blocks_repeat.derivation: The opening ask is an attempt for every product, so it is an offer already made. A step with the same amount and date repeats it.

quotes:
3. From 18 November 2026 (calls on that day included), the overdraft and credit card dispute codes NO-DSP and
   NC-DSP are retired and both are replaced by `NX-QRY`. The loan code NL-DSP does not change.

assumptions: Calls are assumed to take place on or after 30 October 2026. Memo FL-OPS-26-11 items 1, 2 and 4 are applied: band A deadline is the 5th business day, 2026-11-13 is removed from closure days, 2026-11-30 is added, and the overdraft floor is 20%. Pre-memo values are listed under unsupported_rules.
The memo outranks the policy, and the policy outranks the email. Identity allows 2 wrong answers in total, as in policy 2.1 and the API, not the 'three goes' the email guessed.
The personal loan floor is the instalment in bands A and B and the full arrears in band C, per policy 2.4. This overrides the email's 'monthly instalment, full stop'.
Dispute note codes: NO-DSP, NC-DSP and NL-DSP before 18 November 2026. From that date, overdraft and card use NX-QRY via event_changes; the loan keeps NL-DSP.
Band B rolls to the following month's last business day when today is that last business day or later (roll_if_not_after_today).
Band C has no upper bound in the brief ('61 or more'); 100000 is used as the maximum.

Ladder step 1 is the opening ask (full arrears today), since the opening counts as attempt 1. Band attempt limits are copied as given: A 3, B 4, C 3. As a result the floor step is reached only in band B. In band C the 'full on deadline' step repeats the 2nd-business-day step and is skipped but still counted.
Any ladder step dated after the product's deadline uses the deadline (built-in).
Hardship is a direct transfer to the care queue with no notes. The close is handed_over / hardship, and the hardship event note is empty because transfers write no notes.

Restructuring transfers to the plans queue (handed_over / plans). Requests for a person transfer to general (handed_over / general). Asking once whether the agent can help first is the engine default; the brief is silent.
The brief gives no close code for a service error. no_promise with reason 'refused' is used, because 2.11 allows only refused or dispute for no_promise. The product gets an N-SYS note.

The brief does not cover callbacks, third parties, wrong numbers, deceased customers or an unclear identity confirmation. The API outcome not_reached is used with invented reasons: callback, no_callback, wrong_number, deceased, unclear. Callback days, window and ask counts use the defaults.

Defaults are used where the brief is silent: confirm max_asks 2, max_not_talk 2, the 'next weekday' meaning (following_week), clamp_single_date true, one 'anything else' turn after a promise, and no SMS line.
Promise amounts are converted from pounds to whole pence (promise_scale 100).
The postcode is sent in capital letters with one space before the last three characters. Its length varies, so no fixed length is set. The birth year is four digits.
The verify_identity response has no hint field, so no hints are defined.
The not_reached reasons are not in any table in the materials, so the reason code table lists only the outcomes whose reasons the pack gives.
